ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (black/dark grey) across the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to localized water droplet reflections and spray, resulting in a very low macro-level contrast ratio for the fluke body itself.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across both lobes with no detectable contiguous high-contrast geometric blobs or mottling patterns visible on the ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex and symmetrical divergence of the lobe boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with low-amplitude serrations along the inner margins, transitioning to high-amplitude, irregular protrusions at the distal lobe tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward sweep of the lobes with a slight concave curvature along the trailing edge leading toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, three-dimensional clusters of irregular textures localized exclusively at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular protrusions and growth clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) located on the distal terminal edges of both lobes, creating a jagged, non-linear termination of the fluke structure.
